title: How to Watch *NSYNC Member Joey Fatone’s New Docuseries ‘Boy Band Confidential’ Online Free
summary: The new docuseries will include cameos from members of some of your favorite '90s boy bands.
contentText:

Boy bands of the ’90s: the glitz, the glam, the matching outfits and spiky hair. They were certainly a product of the times, but they captivated audiences like no other. What was it like to be a member, and was it really all it’s cracked up to be? All these questions, and more, are sure to be answered in Investigation Discovery’s (ID) new docuseries Boy Band Confidential .

The docuseries is set to premiere on Monday, April 13 and Tuesday, April 14 from 9-11 p.m. EST/PST. It will also be available to stream via HBO Max . According to a press release from Warner Bros., the docuseries will “reveal how the industry transformed young performers into marketable commodities while exposing untold stories of abuse, addiction, and financial manipulation.

How to Watch Boy Band Confidential At a Glance:

- Channel : Investigation Discovery (ID)

- Streaming : DIRECTV , Philo , Sling , Hulu + Live TV , Disney+, Hulu & HBO Max Bundle , Prime Video

- Date/Time : Monday, April 13 and Tuesday, April 14 from 9–11 p.m. EST/PST 

The docuseries will feature cameos and testimonies from icons from the ’90s boy band scene including *NSYNC members Lance Bass, AJ McLean of Backstreet Boys, Nick Lachey of 98 Degrees, Wanya Morris and Shawn Stockman of Boyz II Men, Ashley Parker Angel of O-Town and Brad Fischetti of LFO, among others.

“Being in a boy band was one of the greatest experiences of my life but it also came with challenges we didn’t always understand at the time,” said executive producer of Boy Band Confidential and *NSYNC member Joey Fatone. “This project gave all of us a chance to reflect, to be honest, and to share what really happened behind the spotlight.” Fatone will also be offering his take throughout the docuseries.

Luckily, ’90s boy band fans have a ton of free ways to watch the new docuseries. Keep reading to learn how to watch for free below.

How to Watch Boy Band Confidential Online for Free

As mentioned, the new docuseries will premiere on Monday, April 13 and Tuesday, April 14 from 9–11 p.m. EST/PST.

DIRECTV

watch FOR FREE ON DIRECTV

You can watch the docuseries on ID via DIRECTV’s CHOICE package which is $59.99 for the first month , down from $94.99. This package includes 125+ channels, and everything in DIRECTV’s ENTERTAINMENT package. The package also includes a five-day free trial, allowing you to tune in to the docuseries without spending a dime.

Philo

Watch for free on Philo

Sling

Watch on Sling Blue

Sling Blue is another option to watch the docuseries. The service costs $54.99 a month and includes 40-plus channels, including ID. With your subscription, you’ll have access to the boy band docuseries, along with all the live sports and news you could ever want. Unfortunately, Sling Blue does not have a free trial option.

Hulu + Live TV

watch for Free on HulU + live TV

Another option for our readers is a Hulu + Live TV subscription , given that ID is included in the live TV channel lineup. A subscription to the service (with ads) will cost approximately $89.99 per month , while the plan without ads goes for $99.99 per month . This subscription gives you access to the titles in Hulu’s library, along with live TV programs 24/7. If you aren’t sure about your subscription, the streaming service offers a three-day free trial to test it out.

Disney+, Hulu, HBO Max Bundle

stream with this hulu, Disney+ & HBO MAX Bundle

If you’re looking to watch the docuseries while saving some cash in the process, we’d also recommend watching via Hulu’s Disney+ and HBO Max bundle . The bundle includes all three streaming services with ads for $19.99 a month or $32.99 a month without ads . Whichever tier you choose, you’ll be able to stream the docuseries via HBO Max, while saving money because this plan is miles cheaper than just subscribing to each streamer separately.

Prime Video

watch for free on prime video

You can also watch the docuseries via Prime Video. With your subscription to Amazon Prime, you’ll be able to add HBO Max to your Amazon Prime Video account as an additional subscription channel. This allows you to stream HBO Max content directly within the Prime Video app for a fee of $10.99 a month . If you don’t already have access to Prime Video, you’ll need a subscription to Amazon Prime, which is $14.99 after a 30-day free trial. Once you’ve secured your membership, you’ll gain access to Prime Video, and add on HBO Max to start streaming the docuseries online.
